comment: A row is read only when its left or right jack has a cable in it (MultiSwitcher.cpp:338). The DIR switch is configured Down, Random, Up from the bottom position up, and 'down' means down the panel: in that position each trigger raises the index. During a crossfade both the outgoing and incoming rows are summed, which is why the output is clamped. The IN and OUT jacks carry whatever is patched, so they get no family.
